intro: Applicants apply online through PUP iApply, submit their requirements on-site at the GS Registrar's Office, take the Graduate School Entrance Exam (GSEE) and pass an interview before enrolling in the MS CpE or PhD CpE.

steps.title: Apply online
steps.text: Fill in the application on PUP iApply (open from November 1 to December 4, 2026). Prepare your 2 x 2 inch colored photo first. Ignore the notice that your application is still queued for 7-20 working days and go straight to the on-site submission.

steps.title: Submit your requirements on-site
steps.text: Bring the complete requirements to the GS Registrar's Office. Incomplete requirements will not be accepted or processed.

steps.title: Pay the entrance exam fee
steps.text: After your documents are verified, pay PhP 500.00 at the Cashier's Office using your printed Payment Voucher.

steps.title: Take the GSEE
steps.text: Exam slots are limited. The date and time will be announced.

steps.title: Interview
steps.text: Meet the Program Chair and/or the Dean.

steps.title: Enroll
steps.text: If you meet all prerequisites and pass the interview, submit the enrollment documents to the School Registrar.

sections.title: Schedule and venue
items: Online application: November 1 to December 4, 2026
Exam schedule: date, time and other details to be announced (limited slots only)
Exam venue: 2nd / 3rd Floor, GS Building, M.H. Del Pilar Campus
On-site submission: GS Registrar's Office, G/F, M.H. Del Pilar Campus
Office hours: Monday to Friday (except national holidays), 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM
Entrance exam fee: PhP 500.00, paid to the Cashier's Office after verification of your documents

sections.title: Before you apply online
items: 2 x 2 inch colored photo, taken recently, white background, formal pose, with complete name tag
Saved as JPEG (.jpg or .jpeg), not more than 300 KB, on your computer or USB device
PUP iApply works best on Chrome, Firefox, Safari or Edge
sections.note: After applying online, you can view and print your payment voucher.

sections.title: Master's: requirements
items: Downloaded and signed GSEE Application Form, with the 2 x 2 colored photo you uploaded online
Transcript of Records from the last school attended (original and photocopy/CTC)
PSA Birth Certificate (original and photocopy)
PSA Certificate of Marriage, for married female applicants only (original and photocopy)
Printed copy of the downloaded Payment Voucher
Certificate of Employment or Service Record (original)
NBI or Police Clearance valid within the last 6 months, or Good Moral Certificate from employer (original; not required if employed in PUP)
Medical Certificate ("Fit to Study") within the last 6 months (original; not required if employed in PUP)
Updated Curriculum Vitae/Resume, including research works and publications, if any
Two-page double-spaced write-up/concept paper on the research area, idea or interest you want to investigate in your thesis (short bond paper, Arial 12)

sections.title: Master's: admission prerequisites
items: Bachelor's degree appropriate or related to the program. If it is in another field, take 18 units of pre-degree courses prescribed in the program of studies
Scholastic rating of at least 2.0, B, or 85% in the undergraduate courses
Qualify in the admission examination
Pass the interview by the Program Chair and/or the Dean

sections.title: Doctorate: requirements
items: Letter of Intent addressed to the Dean of the Graduate School
Recommendation for admission, filled in by your immediate supervisor/head of office
Downloaded and signed GSEE Application Form, with the 2 x 2 colored photo you uploaded online
Transcript of Records from the last school attended (original/CTC)
PSA Birth Certificate (original and photocopy)
PSA Certificate of Marriage, for married female applicants only (original and photocopy)
Printed copy of the downloaded Payment Voucher
Certificate of Employment or Service Record (original)
Medical Certificate ("Fit to Study") within the last 6 months (original; not required if employed in PUP)
Updated Curriculum Vitae/Resume, including research works and publications, if any
Two-page double-spaced write-up/concept paper on the research area, idea or interest you want to investigate in your dissertation (short bond paper, Arial 12)

sections.title: Doctorate: admission prerequisites
items: Appropriate master's degree (with thesis) from a university or college of recognized standing. If it is in another field, take the pre-degree (master's) courses prescribed in the program of studies
Qualify in the admission examination
Pass the interview by the Program Chair and/or the Dean
At least three (3) years of work experience
Each program may impose or recommend additional requirements
sections.note: Applicants with a non-thesis master's degree must enroll in Thesis Writing, pass the Oral Defense and submit final copies of the paper to the Registrar's Office before taking doctorate courses.

sections.title: Enrollment documents (Master's and Doctorate)
items: Printed Admission Record, with 2 x 2 colored photo taken recently, white background, formal pose
Downloaded Pre-Registration Form
Downloaded, printed and signed Undertaking
Honorable Dismissal/Certificate of Transfer Credential
Original Transcript of Records of the highest degree earned (TOR marked "Copy for PUP Graduate School" is submitted within the semester)
sections.note: Submit these to the School Registrar after you pass the admission exam and interview.

sections.title: Schedule of fees
items: Tuition per unit, Master's: PhP 750.00
Tuition per unit, Doctorate: PhP 1,000.00
Miscellaneous fees: PhP 2,725.00
sections.note: Rates are subject to change without prior notice.
